subject: Post-call recap — AtlasHealth discovery & timeline rescope
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@atlashealth.com>, Tom Brooks <tbrooks@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — AtlasHealth discovery & timeline rescope

Hi Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have a clean MAP draft to work from: 

1) Target scope we discussed
   - Pilot: query-based personalization (search + structured slot filling) for care navigation
   - Integration: SSO + VPC peering, sample PHI scoping (redaction at rest)

2) Milestones (first-cut) 
   - Week 1–2: Security & compliance review (Atlas provides questionnaire answers) — owner: Atlas
   - Week 3: Private deployment proof-of-concept (sandbox) — owner: Redwood (Vivek)
   - Week 4–6: Integration testing & data validation — owner: Atlas + Redwood
   - Week 7: Pilot go/no-go (success metrics: latency <200ms p95, NPS uplift) — owner: Atlas

3) Dependencies / blockers
   - SOC2 evidence request (Priya to confirm timeline to share SOC2 summary)
   - Network approval for VPC peering (Atlas infra)
   - Legal review of DPA / liability terms (Tom to coordinate)

4) Proposed commercial cadence 
   - Pricing summary attached (pricing-summary-AtlasHealth.pdf)
   - Proposed close for pilot commitment: originally target 2027-06-11; you flagged internal budget review next month — see below for reforecast ask

Next steps / asks from Atlas: 
- Can you confirm target close window for the pilot commitment? (Requested by 5/21 if possible)
- Share SOC2 snapshot and primary infra contact for peering.

I'll attach a MAP draft (v2) with the milestones above for you to mark up. Monica and Vivek — flag anything missing on the technical or success-metrics side and I'll push an updated MAP to the Drive.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: AtlasHealth-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx, pricing-summary-AtlasHealth.pdf
From: Tom Brooks <tbrooks@atlashealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@atlashealth.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — AtlasHealth discovery & timeline rescope

Thanks Rafael — good summary. A couple of updates from our side: 

- Budget committee pushed our internal approval window out by two weeks (we now expect a decision between 6/20 and 6/27). That means the pilot purchase order would likely be signed around 6/28 at the earliest.
- SOC2 snapshot: I can share our security liaison's contact (Priya will pull the SOC2 summary and the list of controls we need Redwood to confirm).
- Network: infra will need a short runbook for peering; I expect that to be ready after approval.

Can you revise the MAP target close to late June? If you can keep the MAP flexible (canary split or delayed rollout) that helps our procurement timeline. Also please confirm whether we can start the sandbox work prior to PO (we may be able to provide a limited test environment under NDA).

Tom
VP, Engineering | AtlasHealth
T: 617-555-2219

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call recap — AtlasHealth discovery & timeline rescope

Looping internal owners. Rafael — thanks, good capture. Quick notes from implementation perspective: 

- Vivek: please confirm sandbox capacity and whether we can provision a single-GPU sandbox that is allowed pre-PO under a short NDA. If yes, list constraints (token limits, retention).
- Stephanie: legal will want to understand where Atlas expects liability carveouts and whether we can accept a 60-day data retention exception for the pilot.
- I'll draft a revised MAP timeline that moves the pilot commitment to 2027-06-28 and splits the integration milestones so we can start sandbox tasks earlier (parallelize security questionnaire work).

I'll update the MAP and push v3 to the Drive once Vivek confirms the sandbox constraints.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call recap — AtlasHealth discovery & timeline rescope

All, quick update on sandbox and MAP v3 plan: 

- Sandbox: we can provision a single-GPU sandbox under NDA with the following constraints: 2M tokens/day, KV cache cleared nightly, 14-day ephemeral logs. No PHI may be stored in sandbox; any masked data only.
- I'll attach a short runbook stub to the Drive (runbook-sandbox-Atlas.md) and a configuration fragment for VPC peering (peering-template.json) — I'll surface the peering template to Tom's infra once they confirm approval.
- MAP v3: Monica, Rafael — if we set the pilot commitment target to 2027-06-28, we can run sandbox + security questionnaire in parallel and keep the pilot start in early July if procurement completes on the 6/28 PO. That gives Atlas time and keeps momentum.

Action items: 
- Rafael: push MAP v3 to the Drive with updated milestone owners and adjusted target close (6/28).
- Monica: confirm legal asks and retention exception language; copy Stephanie.
- Tom/Priya (Atlas): please confirm SOC2 window and whether Atlas can share their infra contact for peering.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: runbook-sandbox-Atlas.md (Drive link), peering-template.json (Drive link)
